description: This file implements logging functionalities for the Rialto project, including log level management, log handlers for file and journald logging, and utility functions for logging messages with different severity levels and components.

methods.name: componentToString
methods.description: Converts a RIALTO_COMPONENT enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: levelToString
methods.description: Converts a RIALTO_DEBUG_LEVEL enum value to its string abbreviation.

methods.name: fdLogHandler
methods.description: Handles logging messages by writing them to a file descriptor, formatting timestamp, level, component, thread ID, and message.

methods.name: journaldLogHandler
methods.description: Handles logging messages by sending them to syslog with formatted metadata.

methods.name: rialtoLog
methods.description: Core logging function that formats messages and dispatches to appropriate handlers based on environment and configuration.
